OD6Jb7sUz8g.title: What Is Faith? | The Gift We Are Commanded to Receive
OD6Jb7sUz8g.description:
What is faith? Is it blind belief, divine gift, or something else?

While developing my Statement of Faith, I found myself not merely defining the doctrine of faith, but also considering how I derived that doctrinal definition, as well as the implications of my understanding of faith for my broader theology, and more importantly, my relationship with God.

In this episode of The Wisdom Crucible, I examine several beliefs regarding the nature of faith in the light of Scripture in an attempt to burn away the chaff and find the pure gold within.
_____________________________________
Context
This episode started with a question: a simple and yet monumentally important question from my pastor regarding the nature of faith. He asked me if I believed that faith was gift, and if so, how we receive it.

I was confident that faith is indeed a gift… in some abstract sense that I wasn’t quite sure at first how to define carefully enough. I was also confident that I could figure it out and present the philosophy of Scripture in a quick 20 min study on the nature of faith… which obviously is not where the Lord took me on this journey of study.

However, I’m going to say that despite failing to keep it simple and concise enough for a general audience I believe that I failed upward in a sense, because the unexpected breadth and depth of work that I have done in the last several months studying the nature and discussion of faith has produced priceless fruit in my spirit.

I hope the results of my labor will be of help to others, but even if not, it’s brought me closer to the God of my faith, and that’s enough for me.
_____________________________________

_qVItgpBYvg.title: What Is Fundamental for The Faith? | A Confession of Continuity
_qVItgpBYvg.description:
What is truly fundamental to The Faith?
While all doctrine is important, not all doctrines carry the same weight, and not all are worth dividing over. While developing a statement of faith, I found that the process was doing more than simply organizing and stating beliefs.
It was exposing the foundation beneath them, and that foundation requires more than initial establishment.
It requires maintenance.
In this episode of The Wisdom Crucible, I want to do, even at great length, exactly what I suggested at the end of the video description for the first episode of my playlist titled Questions in the Crucible…
Let Scripture speak, and philosophy sit at its feet.
_____________________________________
Context
Shortly after I accepted the request to help draft a new statement of faith for my local church, I began reviewing other such statements and articles on writing them. I quickly realized that many of them did very little to clarify what the associated churches actually believed. They seemed to often rely on a combination of ambiguous and abstract phrases, which invites the inevitable outcome of people filling in the gaps with their predetermined understanding of Christian doctrine.
That strategy didn’t seem particularly helpful to me, or to my pastor, so we agreed that a more detailed explanation of The Faith with specific Scriptural references was warranted.
When gaps are left in the explanation, there’s no knowing what kinds of ideas another person may read into those gaps.
This episode is my attempt to fill the biggest gaps with sufficiently clear explanations of the primary and most critical secondary doctrines of The Faith.

QzWQCp8T-QQ.title: Does the Bible Teach Divine Ignorance? | Questions in the Crucible #1
QzWQCp8T-QQ.description:
Does the Bible portray Jesus as ignorant?
If so, what does that mean for His divinity, the Incarnation, and Christianity itself?
In this episode of Questions in the Crucible, I’ve taken a weak version of the argument for divine ignorance, expanded and strengthened it, and presented Scripture’s response exegetically, philosophically, and historically.

The challenge raised by some skeptical minds and critics of Christian theology is this: Certain passages of the Bible seem to present Jesus as lacking omniscience, an essential attribute of God. Therefore, Jesus cannot be truly and fully God.

Faith is not threatened by honest questions. But careless readings, philosophical assumptions, and selective skepticism can obscure what the Bible is actually saying. Sometimes the layers need to be peeled away slowly and methodically so that from understanding we can extract wisdom.
_____________________________________
Context
The original objection that was presented to me, personally, centers on Jesus’ citation of Psalm 82 in John 10 and the claim that He misunderstood its original meaning. While that objection is easily resolved by careful attention to context and logic, it opened a door to a deeper and more serious question:

How does Scripture reconcile the omniscient nature of God with the human nature of the Incarnation of Jesus Christ?

This discussion moves beyond surface-level prooftexts to address the doctrine of the Incarnation itself. I examined how Scripture consistently presents Jesus as fully God and fully man and how apparent limitations in knowledge fit within that framework.
This is not an exercise in rescuing Scripture from difficulty, but an invitation to let the whole counsel of God refine our thinking through thorough exposition with a side of exultation.
_____________________________________

Cl2TfIEjYmA.title: How to Handle Objections to Scripture | Preparing the Crucible
Cl2TfIEjYmA.description:
The power of a question is in the response that it elicits.
This is Episode 0 of Questions in the Crucible, where a question from a skeptic meets an answer from a friend.

That posture is intentional. Jesus made Himself my friend when I had made myself His enemy, and I want to do the same for others while pointing them to Him.

Intelligent skeptics and confused Christians require more than mere soundbites and pithy observations. I hope the responses that I provide through this method will be optimally thorough for those wrestling with genuine intellectual doubts.

Faith is not merely an intellectual endeavor, but we cannot truly divorce our intellect from our emotional mind and spirit.

The intellect is part of the person, and I don’t want to leave any part of the person unattended.
_____________________________________
Context
In this episode, I explain the methodology for response to tough questions — a method designed to filter out noise and honors both the emotional weight and theological implications of the question.

However, knowledge without understanding does not lead to wisdom. A purely mechanical explanation of methodology would hardly bridge the gap from knowledge to understanding. The Wisdom Crucible exists to foster biblical wisdom, so it seems more likely divine inspiration than accident that I set out to write a brief instructional summary — and instead wrote a 20 min sermon.

mGEcs8slGaI.title: Reverse of the Curse: The Signet Ring Returns | HAGGAI 2:10–23
mGEcs8slGaI.description:
What does God do when His people bring Him offerings with unclean hands?
By examining the dramatic conclusion to the oracles of Haggai, we can see God’s judgement of the remnant of Israel for issues deeper than simply delayed temple reconstruction. Through a reminder of purity laws, covenant agreement, and the restoration of the signet-ring promise, God reveals that rituals and proximity to holy things do NOT substitute consecration of the heart.
Through Haggai, God does more than merely confront neglect —
He unveils the path from defilement to blessing.
_____________________________________
Context
This is the second and final episode of my study through the book of Haggai. The Wisdom Crucible exists to forge understanding through careful, Scripture-anchored study and reflection. In this passage, the LORD instructs His people through a priestly syllogism, a call to moral renewal, and a reaffirmation of the Davidic promise.
These elements serve to teach us how God transforms polluted offerings to true worship — and how holiness, obedience, and hope ultimately converge in the coming of Christ, the Son of David, the coming Son of Zerubbabel.

In this episode I present an analogy to help illustrate the way that our relationship with — and yielding to — God influences all of our other responsibilities and relationships.

It's a bit like pitting application versus principle, but one flows from the other, and I wanted to communicate that as part of this message.

#TheWisdomCrucible #Bible #Trinity #Apologetics #Christianity #Scripture #Theology #BiblicalTeaching

No matter how much you read it, the Word of God always has more to give. Your changing circumstances reveal new layers of need, met with new revelation of His wisdom.

#TheWisdomCrucible #Bible #BibleStudy #Faith #Christianity #ScriptureStudy #Wisdom #GodsWord

9kltXjyKiUI.title: Christmas Means No One Is Left Behind
9kltXjyKiUI.description:
Jesus came, died, and rose again — that’s why Christmas matters. Merry Christmas, and thank God for our Savior.

#TheWisdomCrucible #Christmas #MerryChristmas #Jesus #Savior #Christ #Gospel #Emmanuel #Nativity #Christianity #Faith

5e_bFOQDnG0.title: Preach The Word, Not Your Brand
5e_bFOQDnG0.description:
Motivational messaging is meaningless when divorced from the one true Gospel. Preach the Bible the way Paul did — expositional exultation — and lead your people to trust the Lord more than they trust you.

#TheWisdomCrucible #Preaching #Gospel #BibleTeaching #Christianity #ExpositoryPreaching #TeachTheWord #Scripture

KFI38ZdOSWY.title: The Bitter Seasons the Sweet
KFI38ZdOSWY.description:
Life can leave a bitter taste in your mouth. You can dwell on the bitterness, or you can learn to appreciate how it seasons the sweetness of the blessings God gives now and forever through hope in Jesus Christ.

#TheWisdomCrucible #Hope #Encouragement #Faith #Christianity #Joy #Suffering #Blessings #Inspiration

xSesIhhAZ-A.title: A Blessing from Beyond the Pages
xSesIhhAZ-A.description:
Stories sometimes speak of ancient words and blessings, but perfect peace comes from the God who sees you, knows you, and walks with you. This blessing is for you.

#TheWisdomCrucible #Blessing #Peace #Encouragement #Christianity #Eragon

XVzQhjP1P3w.title: Teaching vs Preaching
XVzQhjP1P3w.description:
To teach is to explain. To preach is to PROCLAIM! Proper preaching is expository exultation - exposing Scripture and exalting its message.
Preachers — distribute the Word of God with boldness and reverence.
Listeners — test every message with the light of Scripture.

#thewisdomcrucible #Preaching #Teaching #JohnPiper #ExpositoryPreaching #FaithfulTeaching

pVJ8yoixVhQ.title: Before the Feast Begins…
pVJ8yoixVhQ.description:
Thanksgiving is a time for gratitude, not gluttony. Proverbs 23 warns against overeating, and fasting may be the reset your heart needs around times of feasting. For more reflections and full teachings, follow The Wisdom Crucible.

#Bible #Proverbs #Gluttony #Thanksgiving #TheWisdomCrucible

5aSR8NQLifg.title: Follow To the Finish Line
5aSR8NQLifg.description:
Running to the finish line is more important than following your leaders. Don’t follow them if they are running off track. Keep your eyes ahead, and know that the finish line is the open arms of Jesus Christ.

#TheWisdomCrucible #RunTheRace #FixYourEyesOnJesus #FaithJourney #ChristianLeadership #Philippians3

SpSbOn1CBsc.title: Working through Sickness
SpSbOn1CBsc.description:
Even in weakness, God strengthens those who seek Him. Through brain fog and sleepless nights, His Word keeps the lamp lit. The Spirit sustains where the body fails — the work continues from obedience.

#TheWisdomCrucible #FaithInTrials #SpiritualStrength #EnduringFaith #BibleStudy

HmDuPr7HxUE.title: Heat and Living Water
HmDuPr7HxUE.description:
Life can leave you feeling burned and dried out, but the Spirit pours living water from John 7 to the dry bones in Ezekiel 37. You can handle the heat with the Spirit’s water now — or face the drought by yourself later. Choose wisely.

#TheWisdomCrucible #LivingWater #HolySpirit #DryBones #John7 #Ezekiel37

zQdwujoro0Q.title: Love — Accident or Choice
zQdwujoro0Q.description:
Love isn’t something you “fall” into and out of. The Bible defines love as intentional action - a choice that reflects Christ’s sacrifice. Choosing love brings stability where “falling” fails. Love like Jesus enables families to endure.

#TheWisdomCrucible #BiblicalMarriage #ChooseLove #FaithfulLove #ChristianFamily

YkpogwCLMlI.title: Truth and Politics — Don’t Apologize for the Truth
YkpogwCLMlI.description:
If something needs to be called “politically correct,” maybe it isn’t logically correct. Politics should use truth, not rewrite it. God is the source of all truth - moral, logical, and political. Speak truth boldly, with gentleness and love, as Scripture commands.

#TheWisdomCrucible #TruthInChrist #BiblicalTruth #FaithAndPolitics #ChristianCourage #1Peter3v15

lq-mY9sZ5K4.title: Do You Dare Stand Before the Light?
lq-mY9sZ5K4.description:
If the light of truth shined into your heart, what would it reveal? If Jesus questioned your beliefs, could you answer? Now is the time to test the strength of your convictions - before you must testify for every choice you have made. For more reflections and full teachings, follow The Wisdom Crucible.

#walkinthelight #JesusTeaches #SpiritualBlindness #TheWisdomCrucible

ojI5U_s7RqY.title: Gearing Up For War
ojI5U_s7RqY.description:
Are you wearing the full armor of God? If not, stop what you're doing, read Ephesians 6 v. 10-18 and equip yourself, les the enemy find you unprepared and exposed! For more reflections and full teachings, follow The Wisdom Crucible.

#ArmorOfGod #SpiritualWarfare #ChristianEncouragement #TheWisdomCrucible

5vn7Ip6Z60w.title: Pondering Priorities
5vn7Ip6Z60w.description:
How do you think about priorities? A practical list from first to last, or simply putting God first and letting the rest fall into place? Knowing your first, second, and third can help with practical decisions, but focus first on making God your true priority. You might be amazed at how everything else begins to align — and how the impact of your relationship with Him ripples through every other part of your life. For more reflections and full teachings, follow The Wisdom Crucible.

#ChristianPriorities #ChristianFaith #FaithInAction #TheWisdomCrucible

bb65k6s86oE.title: It’s Not About Winning Debates
bb65k6s86oE.description:
1 Peter 3:15 calls us not only to have faith, but to defend it — not to win arguments, but to win hearts. Be ready to give a reason for the hope within you, with gentleness, humility, and respect. For more reflections and full teachings, follow The Wisdom Crucible.

#BibleStudy #FaithReflection #TheWisdomCrucible

WsM6KTSY8Wk.title: What about the superscript?
WsM6KTSY8Wk.description:
The superscript tells us who’s speaking — and verse 1 reveals why it matters. Sometimes the smallest statements carry the weight of prophecy. For more reflections and full teachings, follow The Wisdom Crucible.

#BibleStudy #MessianicPsalm #TheWisdomCrucible

sv_VaxKYaZU.title: 5 Years Ago, I Didn’t Want to Teach
sv_VaxKYaZU.description:
I never liked the idea of teaching or the sound of my own voice. But the more I listened to God instead of myself, the more I couldn’t stop speaking about the Gospel of Jesus Christ. For more reflections and full teachings, follow The Wisdom Crucible.

#FaithReflection #Calling #TheWisdomCrucible

hbMqhPMh_mM.title: Does the Bible Teach Divine Ignorance? | Questions in the Crucible #1
hbMqhPMh_mM.description:
Does the Bible portray Jesus as ignorant, and if so, what does that mean for His divinity and the doctrine of the Incarnation?

In this episode of Questions in the Crucible, I take a commonly raised objection against the deity of Christ, strengthen it to its most serious form, and examine Scripture’s response exegetically, philosophically, and historically. Certain passages are often claimed to present Jesus as lacking omniscience, an essential attribute of God, and therefore unable to be truly and fully divine.

Faith is not threatened by honest questions. But careless readings, philosophical assumptions, and selective skepticism can obscure what the Bible is actually saying. This discussion moves beyond surface-level prooftexts to address how Scripture consistently presents Jesus as fully God and fully man, and how apparent limitations in knowledge fit within that framework.

This is not an attempt to rescue Scripture from difficulty, but an invitation to let the whole counsel of God refine our thinking. Let Scripture speak, and philosophy sit at its feet.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

D-8vsrJfhjo.title: How to Handle Objections to Scripture | Preparing the Crucible
D-8vsrJfhjo.description:
The power of a question is in the response that it elicits.

This is Episode 0 of Questions in the Crucible, where a question from a skeptic meets an answer from a friend.

Faith is not merely an intellectual endeavor, but we cannot truly divorce our intellect from our emotional mind and spirit. The intellect is part of the person, and I don’t want to leave any part of the person unattended.
In this episode, I explain the methodology for response to tough questions, a method designed to filter out noise and honors both the emotional weight and theological implications of the question. However, knowledge without understanding does not lead to wisdom. A purely mechanical explanation of methodology would hardly bridge the gap from knowledge to understanding. The Wisdom Crucible exists to foster biblical wisdom, so it seems more likely divine inspiration than accident that I set out to write a 10 min summary of methodology and instead wrote a 20-minute sermon.

Never forget in the darkness what you have learned in the light.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

jwPeaTSb3Q4.title: What Is Fundamental for The Faith? | A Confession of Continuity
jwPeaTSb3Q4.description:
What is truly fundamental to The Faith?
While all doctrine is important, not all doctrines carry the same weight, and not all are worth dividing over.

While developing a statement of faith, I found that the process was doing more than simply organizing and stating beliefs. It was exposing the foundation beneath them, and that foundation requires more than initial establishment. It requires maintenance.

In this episode of The Wisdom Crucible, I want to do, even at great length, exactly what I suggested at the end of the video description for the first episode of my playlist titled Questions in the Crucible… Let Scripture speak, and philosophy sit at its feet. This episode is my attempt to provide sufficiently clear explanations of the primary and most critical secondary doctrines of The Faith.

Better to bow in submissive unity under the Savior than to stand proud and guilty before the Judge.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

i5lYVmOb-2w.title: I am Darth Vader
i5lYVmOb-2w.description:
Have you ever considered how a person can become their own worst enemy?
This allegorical reflection depicts a confession of descent into darkness through fear, pride, ambition, and the illusion of control — using the familiar voice of a fallen hero redeemed by a hope that defeated his hatred.

The confession isn’t the end though, because this reflection pivots at the turning point of the Gospel: The Son of God stepped into suffering on our behalf, defeating death, and offering eternal life to all who repent and believe.

It wasn’t too late for me.
It isn’t too late for you.

A journey through the shadows of fear and pride leads to destruction. Walk with The Word to turn on the light.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

p9GwVD4BN2A.title: Equipping the Armor | A Call to Action
p9GwVD4BN2A.description:
Your call to action: equip the full armor of God every day.

The war has already been won in eternity, but our present battle continues until the new creation is revealed. In this reflection, I encourage you to prepare for the spiritual conflict that comes against every citizen of God’s kingdom by putting on the armor He has provided: truth, righteousness, readiness, faith, salvation, and his Word.

God provides the means. We provide the obedience.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

xGXqVyt79MM.title: RIPPLE ANALOGY — Properly Prioritizing Relationships
xGXqVyt79MM.description:
Even the farthest drop in an ocean trembles at the stone’s touch.

In this reflective message, I share an analogy that illustrates how our relationship with God influences every other part of life. When we give Him His rightful place at the center, the impact radiates outward, shaping how we love, lead, and serve in all our other relationships and responsibilities. Rather than a verse-by-verse study, this episode explores a practical synthesis of two common perspectives on Christian priorities: the structured list that orders God, family, and work in sequence, and the principle based approach that places God first and allows every other area to align beneath Him. The truth, I believe, is not in opposition but in flow: one principle giving birth to faithful practice.

Acquire knowledge, synthesize understanding, and refine wisdom. Read, comprehend, and rightly apply.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

k4pHEaDYDOI.title: What Is Faith? | The Gift We Are Commanded to Receive
k4pHEaDYDOI.description:
What is faith? Is it blind belief, divine gift, or something else?

While developing my Statement of Faith, I found myself not merely defining the doctrine of faith, but also considering how I derived that doctrinal definition, as well as the implications of my understanding of faith for my broader theology, and more importantly, my relationship with God.

In this episode of The Wisdom Crucible, I examine several beliefs regarding the nature of faith in the light of Scripture in an attempt to burn away the chaff and find the pure gold within.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

3:43 – The Central Tension
11:13 – Faith Is Not Blind Belief
24:18 – What is Grace?
59:24 – The Emphasis on Reception
2:43:57 – Proximity Does Not Impart Faith
2:49:06 – Faith Produces Fruit Without Boasting
3:19:00 – Acknowledging Remaining Mystery

qZvwWE0XGpE.title: Reverse of the Curse: The Signet Ring Returns | HAGGAI 2:10–23
qZvwWE0XGpE.description:
What does God do when His people bring Him offerings with unclean hands?

Through Haggai, God does more than merely confront neglect. He unveils the path from defilement to blessing. This is the second and final episode of my study through the book of Haggai.

The Wisdom Crucible exists to forge understanding through careful, Scripture-anchored study and reflection. In this passage, the LORD instructs His people through a priestly syllogism, a call to moral renewal, and a reaffirmation of the Davidic promise. These elements serve to teach us how God transforms polluted offerings to true worship, and how holiness, obedience, and hope ultimately converge in the coming of Christ, the Son of David, the coming Son of Zerubbabel.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

k4G6llxkmjw.title: The House of God and the Heart of Man | HAGGAI 1:1–2:9
k4G6llxkmjw.description:
What happens when God’s people grow comfortable while His house remains in ruins?

In this study, we begin our 2-part journey through the book of Haggai, a prophetic call to re examine misplaced priorities and return to faithful obedience. The message given to Israel still speaks powerfully today. When we neglect the spiritual for the material, our efforts become empty, but when we honor God first, He restores purpose and provision. This is the first episode in my study through the book of Haggai.

In The Wisdom Crucible, I aim to refine understanding through careful study and reflection. Here, we consider how God used Haggai to awaken His people from complacency and renew their commitment to build His house, both the physical temple then and the spiritual devotion He still calls His people to today.

May this message move you to consider your ways, bringing every decision beneath the Lord’s authority, so that your life may be aligned with His covenant and filled with His sustaining grace.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

RcxWZ4xc_jc.title: The Order of Melchizedek | PSALM 110 Part 3
RcxWZ4xc_jc.description:
What does it mean that Christ is a Priest forever after the order of Melchizedek?

In this study, we explore how Psalm 110 reveals the unity of kingship and priesthood in Jesus, and how this truth fulfills Old Testament prophecy.

From Genesis to Hebrews, the theme of Melchizedek points to a priesthood that is eternal, righteous, and unlike any that came before. This is the third and final episode in my study through Psalm 110.

In The Wisdom Crucible, I aim to refine understanding through careful study and reflection. Here, we consider how Christ’s eternal reign and perfect intercession bring together justice, mercy, and the unchanging faithfulness of God.

May this message cultivate an attitude rooted in reverence for the King of Peace, who reigns through righteousness, interceding incessantly.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.

ZS0-EpKdimU.title: Who’s who? | PSALM 110 Part 2 – Authorship & Identity
ZS0-EpKdimU.description:
Who is David’s “Lord” in Psalm 110?

This question opens one of Scripture’s most profound mysteries. In this study, we slow down to trace how Jesus used David’s own words to reveal the Messiah’s true identity, and how the Pharisees’ silence exposed the limits of human interpretation.

Through the cross-references in the Gospels and Peter’s affirmation in Acts, we see that the Spirit-inspired words of David point unmistakably to Christ’s authority and divinity. This is the second episode in my three-part study through Psalm 110.

In The Wisdom Crucible, I aim to refine understanding through careful study and reflection. Here, we consider how authorship, inspiration, and revelation converge to display the Lordship of Christ over both Scripture and history.

May every lesson refine your understanding and deepen your love for the Word of God.

For more studies, reflections, and updates, follow The Wisdom Crucible on YouTube and @WisdomCrucible on X.
